scope: Documented G1 single-CSV decoder; actual downloaded archive acceptance pending
joint_columns: Full model joint name + _dof, for example left_knee_joint_dof
source_root_euler: intrinsic ZYX, stored X/Y/Z components; Rz @ Ry @ Rx
resampling: Explicit native timestamps, linear positions/joints and scipy Slerp; no integer decimation, padding or time stretching

sources.evidence: G1Animation.setFrame reads jointData.root_translateX/Y/Z and root_rotateX/Y/Z; uses 120 fps, centimeter/degree units and Euler order ZYX
CSV parse preserves raw column names; setFrame gets each joint with frameData[jointName + _dof], G1 jointNames retain _joint
